component.name: CatTube
component.summary: YouTube for the TV, driven with a remote

description.p: CatTube is a YouTube app for a Linux computer under the TV. It opens full screen and you use it with arrows, OK and Back: a remote, a keyboard or a game controller. There are no ads.

ul.li: Home, Subscriptions, History, Playlists and Channels once you sign in with a code
Search with suggestions, channels first, then a grid of videos
A player made for the remote, with speed, quality, subtitles, chapters, comments and live chat
SponsorBlock skips sponsors and intros, Return YouTube Dislike brings back dislikes
Use the YouTube app on your phone as a remote

description.p: CatTube is not made by or connected to YouTube or Google.
